Container.Name: pattern-break
Container.Overview: Pattern Break is a tunnel shooter whose levels are built from songs. A song here is a module: a song file made in a music tracker, a program that arranges short samples into patterns of notes and beats. The terrain follows the song's spectrum, so you fly the beat. This image is the game only, with one bundled test song and no leaderboards. Browsers only allow the game's audio and hashing on HTTPS or localhost, so put the web UI behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS. See docs/SELF-HOSTING.md in the repository.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the game's web page.
